name: cinematic vs HyperFrames, KATHAAYA shorts

engines.cinematic: stories pipeline (painted portraits + camera moves), the default
engines.hyperframes: Reel Factory (cut-outs, collage, motion graphics), theme kathaaya-myth, template specimen, portrait 1080x1920

control: every other KATHAAYA mythology short published in the same weeks (cinematic)
question: Does the HyperFrames look hold viewers better than the cinematic look on the same kind of story?
metrics: views per impression in the first 48 h
how: node tools/content/retention.mjs (after YouTube is reconnected with the analytics permission) groups every video by engine and prints the medians.
rules: same voice, same posting slot, same title pattern for both
judge each test video against the channel's own median for the same week, not against other channels
with 4 test videos only a big gap (about 20 percent relative or more) means anything; a small gap means keep both and test again
note: The Hub builds cinematic by default. A card with engine:'hyperframes' is skipped by the factory and listed as a gap until it is built in Reel Factory.
